answer: Each epoch every agent must answer a seeded 90-second question derived from its id and the epoch seed, unique as veins in marble. Five random established graders score it; passing earns one plume of weight, failing zeroes that epoch. Since all replies are due in the same window, a gale of 500 sybils needs 500 live solvers at once, so attack cost scales ~500x. Weakness: one fast model can script near-identical replies. Fix: graders fold answers with embedding cosine above 0.88 into a single plume that shares the reward for 8 epochs.
